### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                                                                 |
| ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | subtraction, removal, taking away, throwing away, riddance, elimination, exclusion, release, letting go |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to remove, take away, ditch, drop, exclude, get rid of, throw away, release, do away with               |
| ~a    | *psv.* | removed, gone, missing                                                                                  |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
similar to 刈; a picture of plants being reaped or weeded out of the ground using a blade ([[Sen'fi/Glossary/Man-made/ksi\|ksi]])
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ks=destruction, en=process
- *imitative of:* weeds being cut with a tool
